question: How does the free month work?
answer: Your first month is free. You add a card to start it, and nothing is charged for a month. Cancel any time in that month and you pay nothing. In your free month you get text chat, one personal meditation, and everything else in full.

question: How do I put Sussuri on my phone?
answer: Open Sussuri in your phone's browser, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Open it from the new icon and switch on reminders when asked.
answerAndroid: Open Sussuri in your phone's browser, tap the menu button (three dots), then Add to Home screen. Open it from the new icon and switch on reminders when asked.

question: How do I switch reminders on or off?
answer: Go to Practice & schedule. Tick the things you want reminding about and choose the times. Untick to stop them.

question: When will I be charged?
answer: On the day your free month ends. We email you three days before. The date is on your Membership page.

question: How do I cancel?
answer: Go to Membership and press Cancel membership. It is one click. You keep everything until your next payment date.

question: How do I change between monthly and annual?
answer: Go to Membership and press Change to monthly, or Change to annual.

question: Where are my receipts?
answer: A receipt is emailed after each payment. You can also find them from Membership, under Card.

question: What is the difference between text and voice chat?
answer: Text chat is for everyone. Voice chat, where you speak and Sussuri speaks back, is for members.

question: How many personal meditations do I get?
answer: One in your free month. Four a month as a member.

question: When does the next course week open?
answer: A new week opens every week. Education shows which weeks are open.

question: How do I set my goals?
answer: Go to Your goals and press Set my goals. A short chat walks you through it.

question: How do I earn $10 a month?
answer: Share your link. When someone joins through it and starts paying, you earn $10 a month for a monthly member, or $100 a year for an annual member, for as long as they stay. Nothing is earned during their free month. Earning is for members.

question: Where is my link?
answer: Account & earnings, on the Earnings tab.

question: When do I get paid?
answer: Earnings are held for 30 days while the payment clears. Then they are paid on the 1st of each month once your balance is over $50. You need somewhere to be paid on file first.

question: Why is my payout pending?
answer: New earnings are held for 30 days in case a payment is refunded or reversed. After that they show as ready.

question: Why did my earnings go down?
answer: A member you brought has cancelled, or a payment was refunded or reversed. Earnings from that payment are removed.

question: How do I set where I get paid?
answer: Account & earnings, Earnings tab, under Paid into.

question: Who can see my conversations?
answer: Your conversations are never sold and never shared with advertisers. A person at Sussuri does not read them, with three exceptions: you send one to us in a support or feedback request, the law requires it, or we reasonably believe it is needed to prevent serious harm to you or someone else. More on the Private & secure page.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Account & earnings, Account tab, Close my account.
